<script id="d-js-load-css">
/**
 * There are a few <link> tags with CSS resource in them that are preloaded in the page
 * in each of those there is a "onload" handler which invokes the loadCSS callback
 * defined here.
 * We are monitoring 3 main CSS files - the runtime, the global and the page.
 * When each load we check to see if we can append them all in a batch. If threre
 * is no page css (which may happen on inner pages) then we do not wait for it
 */
(function () {
  let cssLinks = {};
  function loadCssLink(link) {
    link.onload = null;
    link.rel = "stylesheet";
    link.type = "text/css";
  }
  
    function checkCss() {
      const pageCssLink = document.querySelector("[id*='CssLink']");
      const widgetCssLink = document.querySelector("[id*='widgetCSS']");

        if (cssLinks && cssLinks.runtime && cssLinks.global && (!pageCssLink || cssLinks.page) && (!widgetCssLink || cssLinks.widget)) {
            const storedRuntimeCssLink = cssLinks.runtime;
            const storedPageCssLink = cssLinks.page;
            const storedGlobalCssLink = cssLinks.global;
            const storedWidgetCssLink = cssLinks.widget;

            storedGlobalCssLink.disabled = true;
            loadCssLink(storedGlobalCssLink);

            if (storedPageCssLink) {
                storedPageCssLink.disabled = true;
                loadCssLink(storedPageCssLink);
            }

            if(storedWidgetCssLink) {
                storedWidgetCssLink.disabled = true;
                loadCssLink(storedWidgetCssLink);
            }

            storedRuntimeCssLink.disabled = true;
            loadCssLink(storedRuntimeCssLink);

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    storedRuntimeCssLink.disabled = false;
                    storedGlobalCssLink.disabled = false;
                    if (storedPageCssLink) {
                      storedPageCssLink.disabled = false;
                    }
                    if (storedWidgetCssLink) {
                      storedWidgetCssLink.disabled = false;
                    }
                    // (SUP-4179) Clear the accumulated cssLinks only when we're
                    // sure that the document has finished loading and the document 
                    // has been parsed.
                    if(document.readyState === 'interactive') {
                      cssLinks = null;
                    }
                }, 0);
            });
        }
    }
  

  function loadCSS(link) {
    try {
      var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      var noCSS = !!urlParams.get("nocss");
      var cssTimeout = urlParams.get("cssTimeout") || 0;

      if (noCSS) {
        return;
      }
      if (link.href && link.href.includes("d-css-runtime")) {
        cssLinks.runtime = link;
        checkCss();
      } else if (link.id === "siteGlobalCss") {
        cssLinks.global = link;
        checkCss();
      } 
      
      else if (link.id && link.id.includes("CssLink")) {
        cssLinks.page = link;
        checkCss();
      } else if (link.id && link.id.includes("widgetCSS")) {
        cssLinks.widget = link;
        checkCss();
      }
      
      else {
        requestIdleCallback(function () {
          window.setTimeout(function () {
            loadCssLink(link);
          }, parseInt(cssTimeout, 10));
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      throw e
    }
  }
  window.loadCSS = window.loadCSS || loadCSS;
})();
</script>



<script data-role="deferred-init" type="text/javascript">
    /* usage: window.getDeferred(<deferred name>).resolve() or window.getDeferred(<deferred name>).promise.then(...)*/
    function Def() {
        this.promise = new Promise((function (a, b) {
            this.resolve = a, this.reject = b
        }).bind(this))
    }

    const defs = {};
    window.getDeferred = function (a) {
        return null == defs[a] && (defs[a] = new Def), defs[a]
    }
    window.waitForDeferred = function (b, a, c) {
        let d = window?.getDeferred?.(b);
        d
            ? d.promise.then(a)
            : c && ["complete", "interactive"].includes(document.readyState)
                ? setTimeout(a, 1)
                : c
                    ? document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", a)
                    : console.error(`Deferred  does not exist`);
    };
</script>

 <div class="dmDividerWrapper clearfix u_1818063768" data-element-type="dDividerId" data-layout="divider-style-1" data-widget-version="2" id="1818063768"><hr class="dmDivider" style="border-width:2px; border-top-style:solid; color:grey;" id="1712522302"/></div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1351450308" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1351450308" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li><span style="display: unset;">Applicant must be between the ages of 16 – 25 years old.</span></li><li><span style="display: unset;">Applicant must be the child or legal dependent of a worker killed or permanently and totally disabled in a compensable work-related accident or occupational disease with an Oregon employer.</span></li><li><span style="display: unset;">Student applicant and/or deceased/injured worker are not required to be a legal resident of Oregon.</span></li><li><span style="display: unset;">Applicant must be enrolled, accepted, or applying for acceptance as a full-time or part-time student at a university, college or technical school or registered apprentice program.</span></li><li><span style="display: unset;">Academic achievement, aptitude and community service of the applicant are considered.</span></li><li><span style="display: unset;">Documentation Required:</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></li><li class="ql-indent-1"><span style="display: unset;">A completed Kids’ Chance of Oregon Scholarship Application</span></li><li class="ql-indent-1"><span style="display: unset;">Transcript of most recent grades</span></li><li class="ql-indent-1"><span style="display: unset;">Student Account Statement from the university, college, technical school, apprentice program or high school Applicant plans to attend</span></li><li class="ql-indent-1"><span style="display: unset;">Documentation of compensability that the injury or death of the parent or guardian was determined to be an Oregon covered injury or death.</span></li><li class="ql-indent-1"><span style="display: unset;">Essay/Statement Regarding Needs and Goals</span></li><li class="ql-indent-1"><span style="display: unset;">Letter(s) of Recommendation</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></li></ul> 
<p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><span style="display: unset; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">All decisions are at the discretion of the Board of Directors of Kids’ Chance of Oregon, Inc.</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1443341087 dmRespRow" id="1443341087"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1595367166"> <div class="dmRespCol large-12 medium-12 small-12 content-removed" id="1460983231"> <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1933548428" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1933548428" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h6 style="line-height: 1;"><span style="display: unset;">Kid’s Chance Qualifications</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h6> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmDividerWrapper clearfix u_1386051775" data-element-type="dDividerId" data-layout="divider-style-1" data-widget-version="2" id="1386051775"><hr class="dmDivider" style="border-width:2px; border-top-style:solid; color:grey;" id="1141410041"/></div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph u_1606634699" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1606634699" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s; text-align: left; display: block;"><p><span style="display: unset;">Kids Chance is an equal opportunity organization awarding scholarships without consideration of gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, nationality, ethnic origin, or disability. Students may apply at any time, but the application should be submitted at least two months before the scholarship is needed. The Kids Chance board meets at least annually in the spring to consider the upcoming school-year’s scholarship awards. The scholarship will be awarded for a specific period. Each scholarship requires a new application and verification of eligibility; a qualified applicant may reapply for additional periods as needed. Annual scholarship amounts vary based on available funds and applicants’ financial need. </span></p><p><span style="display: unset;"><span class="ql-cursor">﻿</span></span></p></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1965632314 dmRespRow" id="1965632314"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1544184109"> <div class="dmRespCol large-12 medium-12 small-12" id="1307500147"> <div class="u_1899365786 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1899365786" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h6><span style="display: unset;">Application Instruction</span><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h6> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmDividerWrapper clearfix u_1026824471" data-element-type="dDividerId" data-layout="divider-style-1" data-widget-version="2" id="1026824471"><hr class="dmDivider" style="border-width:2px; border-top-style:solid; color:grey;" id="1014285991"/></div> 
 <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1745795557" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <ol class="defaultList ordered"><li><span class="" style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;">Students are encouraged to utilize the Oregon Student Aid’s scholarship portal that provides options to apply for multiple Oregon based scholarships simultaneously for a streamlined process.</span> 
</span><a href="https://oregonstudentaid.gov/scholarships/osac-scholarship-application/ " target="_blank" runtime_url="https://oregonstudentaid.gov/scholarships/osac-scholarship-application/ " type="url" style="display: initial;">https://oregonstudentaid.gov/scholarships/osac-scholarship-application/</a><span class="" style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;"> <br/><br/></span></span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">Alternatively, students may directly apply by completing and submitting an application from the website, along with all supporting documents and return by mail or electronically to:<br/><br/>Kids’ Chance of Oregon, Inc.<br/>Attn: Scholarship Committee<br/>P.O. Box 1728<br/>Lake Oswego, Oregon 97035<br/></span><a href="/" runtime_url="/" type="page" style="display: initial;">www. kidschanceoforegon.com<br/><br/></a><span style="display: initial;">A completed application includes: (a) This Form; (b) An Essay; (c) Letters of Recommendation; (d) Release allowing Kid’s Chance of Oregon to obtain verification of the Oregon covered death or permanent and total disability; (e) Transcript and/or Letter of Good Standing sent to Kid’s Chance of Oregon.<br/><br/></span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">Kid’s Chance of Oregon, Inc. will do a preliminary review of all applications for completeness. If your application is incomplete, you will be contacted and asked to provide the missing information. </span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">The Kids’ Chance of Oregon, Inc. Scholarship Committee will review all complete applications and will verify the eligibility of each Applicant.<br/><br/></span></li><li><span style="display: initial;">Kids’ Chance Board of Directors will review all applications and the recommendations made by the Scholarship Committee and make a final determination regarding the scholarships to be awarded. Scholarships are considered for the purpose of covering program related tuition, books, housing, fees, meal plans and other program related expenses. <br/><br/></span></li><li>Kids’ Chance of Oregon will then notify the applicant of his/her award. Scholarships will be paid directly to the institution consistent with the institution’s instructions and protocol; in the case of an apprenticeship, the funds may be paid directly to the recipient. Scholarships are awarded periodically and subject to enrollment documentation.</li></ol>
